name: Controlling Anger
overview: Scripture teaches that controlling anger is a mark of wisdom and strength, as a person who is slow to anger demonstrates great understanding and self-mastery, surpassing even mighty warriors. The Proverbs emphasize that love and discretion can prevent conflict, with gentle responses turning away wrath while harsh words provoke it. Believers are called to exercise prudence by deferring anger and choosing to forgive offenses, reflecting Christlike humility and grace. Additionally, Romans instructs Christians to avoid repaying evil with evil, instead pursuing honorable conduct in all relationships.
